cases.assertion: AI-specific atomic steps remain skipped for a deterministic non-AI feature.
Stage 15 runs only for a blocked owner, then returns to that owner without lifecycle approval.
A changed source decision invalidates its handoff and all dependent downstream evidence.
Independent findings require a human checkpoint before an authorized remediator writes source.
Observation emits a recommendation; rollback remains disabled until fresh exact authorization.
Every remote action stops for a new per-action authorization and exact immutable target.
Resume occurs only from a checkpoint whose inputs, outputs, gates, authority, and hashes remain valid.
All thirteen mandatory handoffs preserve all four artifact classes and all four invalidation triggers.
